answer.rationale: Pursue an expedited incumbent renewal negotiation, using the low-cost quote as a benchmark and seeking a multi-year structure that achieves the mandated 18% reduction. This retains proven integration and delivery continuity while the line has virtually no capacity to absorb transition disruption. The low-cost vendor's prior onboarding and invoicing history is favorable, but its delivery performance at current critical volumes remains unconfirmed; verify that record alongside the prior benchmark-negotiation result before committing.
